messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] windows version
parts:
Hi

Yes, unfortunately, due to a very minor issue, the packgae has been
removed form CRAN by the CRAN maintainers, and I have failed to sumbit a
new version. I hope to submit very soon, but in the meanwhile, you can
still install it, using:

library(devtools)
install_github("tsDyn", ref="Dev94", username="MatthieuStigler",
subdir="tsDyn")

note if on windows you might need ot install Rtools, as installing tsdyn
requires compilation.

Best

Matthieu
